    positions = [(r,c) for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[r][c] == color]

    visited = set()
    while positions:

        if start in visited: continue
        
        comp_pos = []
        stack = [start]
        while stack:
            cr, cc = stack.pop()
            if (cr,cc) in visited: continue
            visited.add((cr,cc))
            comp_pos.append((cr,cc))
            for dr,dc in [(0,1),(0,-1),(1,0),(-1,0)]:

                if 0<=nr<len(grid) and 0<=nc<len(grid[0]) and grid[nr][nc]==color and (nr,nc) not in visited:
                    stack.append((nr,nc))
        
        rows = sorted(set(r for r,c in comp_pos))
        cols = sorted(set(c for r,c in comp_pos))
        
        holes = []
        for r in range(rows[0], rows[-1]+1):
            for c in range(cols[0], cols[-1]+1):
                val = grid[r][c]
                if val != color and val != bg_color:

                visited.add((cr,cc))
                comp_pos.append((cr,cc))
                
                for dr,dc in [(0,1),(0,-1),(1,0),(-1,0)]:

                    if 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w and grid[nr][nc]==color and (nr,nc) not in visited:

            rows = sorted(set(p[0] for p in comp_pos))
            cols = sorted(set(p[1] for p in comp_pos))
            
            # Count non-bg holes
            holes = [(r,c) for r in range(rows[0], rows[-1]+1) 
                      for c in range(cols[0], cols[-1]+1)
                      if grid[r][c] != color and grid[r][c] != bg_color]
            
            results.setdefault(color, []).append({

                'size': len(comp_pos),
                'holes': holes,
                'hole_count': len(holes),
                'bbox': (rows[0], rows[-1], cols[0], cols[-1])

                'touches_border': (rows[0] == 0 or rows[-1] == h-1 or
